mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 2.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE exceeding 4.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE below 3.5%) and slowing job growth (PAYEMS below 150000 thousand persons) indicate an overheating labor market about to cool, reducing corporate hiring and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 3.5% and PAYEMS is below 150000, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansions characterized by high housing starts (HOUST above 1250 thousand units) and strong retail sales (RSAFS above 500000 million dollars) lead to valuation compression and profit-taking, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST exceeds 1250 and RSAFS exceeds 500000, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates stronger consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through continuous demand expansion.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds rate rise above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 108.5 (index 2017=100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 108.5, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 1200 thousand units) reflect strong consumer demand and economic optimism, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of subsequent 60-day periods.
